title: 건널목 입체교차화 비용부담에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text: Article 3 (Standards for Apportionment of Costs) All expenses incurred in grade separation of a railway crossing, including construction costs and compensation expenses, shall be borne as follows: If the road concerned is a local road, the road management authority and the railway infrastructure manager shall each bear 50 percent of the expenses. If the road concerned is a Si road, Gun road, Gu road, Myeon road, Ri road, or agricultural road, the road management authority shall bear 25 percent and the railway infrastructure manager shall bear 75 percent. <Amended on August 3, 2006>
